# Skelpr

> Repository evidence with file:line citations, within a context budget.
> Connect a coding agent over MCP or use the standalone CLI with a configured
> generation provider. In MCP mode, the agent decides when to call Skelpr.

## Setup and data handling

- Python 3.10+ and Git. Standard setup uses Docker for PostgreSQL, Qdrant and isolated
  validation. External database services are supported.
- Configure an embedding endpoint for semantic search. Standalone generation
  needs a separate model provider. From 0.3.6, plain pip install skelpr includes
  CLI and MCP support.
- Running requires activation. Each activated machine uses one license seat.
  Managed leases check in automatically during licensed use at the interval set in the lease.
- For MCP search, run `skelpr setup --no-configure --no-sandbox`. The standalone
  `skelpr setup --configure` wizard verifies both generation and embeddings.
  `skelpr init` writes `.skelpr.yaml` without prompting. Configure the embedding
  endpoint and model before `skelpr index`. MCP and the HTTP API watch for
  changes by default.
- Hosted embeddings receive indexed text and queries. Hosted generation can
  receive prompts and selected source context. Remote storage and optional
  Langfuse tracing can receive source. The coding agent has its own data policy.
- Request an activation token by email. The website waitlist is for release updates.
- Context limits can exclude relevant evidence. Check reported gaps and request
  more context when needed. Empty search results do not prove absence.

## Case studies

- Sock Shop (September 2026): the historical report shows 59.3% fewer tokens and
  113 to 27 files opened. Retained artifacts do not fully reproduce the published aggregate.
- Django (November 2026), ten Codex tasks: total tokens 437,997 to 274,749 (37.27% fewer), native
  search/read calls 28 to 9, combined rubric score 89/96 to 91/96. Total wall time
  was 534.40 to 521.25 seconds; four tasks were slower with Skelpr.
- Django totals count all input, including cached input, plus output. These are retained
  matched comparisons across successive builds; the questions informed tuning.
  Q8 and Q10 used seeded defects. Neither study establishes general performance
  or results for one frozen release.
